name: RecordProperty
description: Real-estate property record. Renders as a teaser card (image, tag pill, title, address line, FERTIG/FLAECHE/EINH. meta row) and as its own page at /property/<slug> — a typed header (hero, gallery, teaser) above a free content body that accepts any active Content Block.
when_to_use: One record per listed property; list them on pages via the Teaser content element (record_type: property, manual picks or auto query with buy/rent filter).
capabilities: listing type buy/rent controlling price display (total vs. monthly), 'Preis auf Anfrage' when price is empty
status (new, available, reserved, sold) and tag presets with free-text tag_custom override for the card pill
address, price, area, rooms, units, construction years; card meta shows year_completed, ca. area m2, and units when > 1
hero image (card + header) and page-only gallery (up to 30 images/videos)
content_elements: inline tt_content body — editors drop any active Content Block onto the property page, exactly as on a normal page

renamed_from.name: Property
renamed_from.note: Record types carry a Record marker so they can never be confused with a content element of the same name (DL #030). The public slug is unchanged ('property'), so Supabase records.type and every /property/<slug> URL still match; the TYPO3 table moved from tx_factorycore_property to tx_factorycore_record_property — see migrations/1.1.0/typo3.md.

ai.prompt_summary: Property record (tx_factorycore_record_property, type slug 'property'): title (required), slug (required, auto from title — the record's URL segment in /property/<slug>), teaser (1-3 sentences, page only), listing_type (buy|rent), status (new|available|reserved|sold), tag (neubau|umbau|sanierung|bestand|denkmal|gewerbe|mfh) + tag_custom override, address_street/zip/city/country, price (nullable — empty renders 'Preis auf Anfrage') + price_type (total|monthly), area_m2, rooms, units (WE), year_built, year_completed (card 'FERTIG'), hero_image, gallery (max 30), content_elements (the page body — any block).
ai.content_guidelines: Titles are project/property names, not sentences. Teaser 1-3 sentences. Use tag_custom only for combined labels like 'NEUBAU & UMBAU'. Use status sold for rented-out listings too.

field_hints.price: Leave empty for 'Preis auf Anfrage'; price_type monthly makes it read as EUR/Monat.
field_hints.units: Only shown on the card when greater than 1 (as '{units} WE').
field_hints.content_elements: The record's page body. Any active Content Block, rendered by FactoryPageRenderer below the typed header — same as a page's content.
